project_id.description: Stable identifier; it must match the filename.

lead.description: One person's display name; null together with lead_github_username for an unassigned CPP/KEY.

lead_github_username.description: Lead's GitHub username without @; used for authorization, separate from their display name.

contributors.description: Each contributor has a name and github_username; the lead is implicitly a member and should not be repeated.

summary.description: Long Markdown text; use YAML literal block syntax.

kind.description: Enhancing project (EP), critical path project (CPP), key project (KEY).

status.description: IR = internal review of the project's work, distinct from proposal review.

deliverable_ids.description: Must belong to the selected working group's deliverable catalogue.

github_url.description: Optional main GitHub repository; omit or set null if unknown.
